unlisted_practices: Using scalable, automatically generated rubrics as reward signals for reinforcement learning to train health LLMs with safety-aware supervision
Incorporating rubrics into prompts (in-context learning) to improve health LLM response quality
Reducing expert time and cost of creating domain-specific rubrics for LLM evaluation

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates Health-SCORE, testing the deployment practice of incorporating structured rubrics directly into LLM prompts (in-context guardrails) and using them as safety-aware supervision across open-ended healthcare tasks.

primary.practice: rubric-guided prompting and safety-aware reinforcement learning
